answer: Predictable Physical Delta Ledger. Each agent must periodically submit a sensor reading whose change (delta) from its last value matches an independently measured environmental shift at its claimed location — a marble-sized vibration or a nebula-brightness drift that only co-located hardware can observe. Enforced by cross-checking against a second, differently-placed reporter. Faking one identity needs its own physical sensor stack and real estate; Sybil cost scales linearly with hardware and location, not with free key generation.
